title: NES
description: An iNES cartridge image: the 16-byte header and a trainer as one row each, the PRG one ca65 segment a 16 KB bank (16 KB at $C000; up to 32 KB at $8000; with a mapper the last bank fixed at $C000 and the others at $8000, as at power-on), the CHR beside the source taken in with .incbin; flow from the NMI, reset and IRQ vectors in the last six bytes, which are written as words. The PPU's and the APU's registers by their documented names; an ld65 configuration places the segments.
